messages:
release-eng: Rolling out release 2023.2.4 to prod now. Canary at 10% (rl-78321). Change window until 18:00 PT. @sam can you watch the canary?

deploy-bot: rollout started id=rl-78321 stage=canary instances=12 percent=10

sam: seeing a spike in 5xx from the canary group, ~18% error rate on auth calls.

jordan: which 5xx? client or upstream? any logs?

sam: upstream auth failing. Example log: `ERROR: Missing environment variable: EXTERNAL_OAUTH_SECRET`

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/service/auth_client.py", line 72, in fetch_token
    key = os.environ["EXTERNAL_OAUTH_SECRET"]
KeyError: 'EXTERNAL_OAUTH_SECRET'
```

maria: heads-up: we rotated the external oauth secret in staging last week and renamed the key to `EXTERNAL_OAUTH_KEY_V2` to support envelope encryption. Looks like prod still expects the old env var name.

alicia: Canary is at 25% now. If this is a config/secret mismatch we should consider rollback to avoid wider impact.

sam: +1 — recommend pausing rollout and rolling back. Canary failing is symptomatic of env parity drift after secret rotation. We can hotpatch prod to add compatibility var but need SRE help with KMS write.

release-eng: Agreed. Pausing rollout. @deploy-bot execute rollback rl-78321 -> rl-78320 (command: `deploy rollback --id rl-78321 --to rl-78320`)

deploy-bot: rollback initiated id=rb-1127 status=started target=rl-78320

devops-bot: NOTE: CI pipeline failed previously to write the compatibility secret because prod KMS key policy denied the pipeline principal after the rotation. Alias in use: `alias/ext-rot-2026`. Manual write required or policy update.

jordan: I'll open a tiny compatibility PR to read `EXTERNAL_OAUTH_KEY_V2` falling back to `EXTERNAL_OAUTH_SECRET` and log a deprecation warning. Also will coordinate a manual secret write to KMS once policies are confirmed. ETA ~30m.

alicia: Sounds good. Documenting in the release notes and incident doc: "rollback due to env var name mismatch after secret rotation". We'll schedule the follow-up deploy outside peak window after the compatibility change and KMS policy update.

sam: After rollback, error rate dropped back to baseline. Monitoring for 10m :white_check_mark:

jordan: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4587 — includes dual-var read + telemetry; will run canary in staging and then coordinate a controlled re-deploy to prod once ops confirms secret write.

maria: Ops to confirm KMS policy update, will post when done.

alicia: Thanks everyone. Postmortem entry will include root cause: staging/prod secret key name drift after rotation. Action items: (1) add dual-read compatibility (jordan) (2) fix KMS write policy for pipeline (maria/devops) (3) add a pre-release env parity check for secret key names (release-eng). :thumbsup:
